items.reading: Each touched record is one stored value, in an ID-like column (a column named Id or ending in Id / Id__c, case-insensitive), that begins with '#'. The item reads it as the Salesforce id with a spurious leading '#': the real id is the value with the '#' removed (always exactly one '#' followed by an 18-character id), and it is the same entity as the unprefixed id in the parent table. Key: table, column, and the row's own Id with any '#' removed.
